title: Zainab Tumahare Bacche Margaye
body:
Zainab Tumahare Bacche Margaye
Garibo Muztarib Hussian
Ye Roke Kar Rahete Bain
Kaise Tumko Chain Aye
<<DIVIDER>>
Kaise Tumko Sabr Aye
Utha Ke Lashe Laya Hoo
Main Pursa Dene Aya Hoo
Inka Haal Too Dekho
<<DIVIDER>>
Aai Mere Bahen Utho
Tumhare Pyase Ladle
Lahoo Me Dube Agaye
Nanhe Neem Che Thame
<<DIVIDER>>
Kar Ke Shaan Se Hamle
Baala Ke Ban Me So Gaye
Tumhare Laal Khogaye
Pyare Chand Se Chehre
<<DIVIDER>>
Aun-o-muhammed Ke
Hai Khak-o- Khoon Me Bhare
Badan Sae Sar Juda Huve
Kis Khadar The Bechain
<<DIVIDER>>
Haq Pe Jaan Dene Ki
Diler Pyase Be Watan
Nisar Hogaye Behan
Aao Deklo Ek Baar
<<DIVIDER>>
Karlo Aakhri Deedar
O Gham Zada Behan Meri
Ye Ab Na Ayenge Kabhi
